items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: it was that time that Milt was getting interested in my recording--- for him and that's when all the recordings started.

ctx.x: Your trumpet -- I mean your cornet?

Yes - he played it; he just could everything. And, he was a hell of an arranger on top of it you know. And, it was that time that Milt was getting interested in my recording--- for him and that's when all the recordings started. And, ---
Is that when you first really got involved with Condon then, too?
